clippyCommand: cargo +stable clippy --offline --locked --manifest-path horizon/native-core/Cargo.toml --lib --bin classic_pillar_math_probe -- -D warnings -A clippy::too_many_arguments
arityPolicy: Matches the existing Horizon host allowance for unchanged source API arity; the initial standalone command without that allowance reports six existing arity warnings.
scope: Core library cache tests and targeted compilation/lint. Independent pillar arithmetic comparisons have their own separate report.
